checks.check: every race row has its 11 fields, votes as a number and a percent (none only with no count on file)
no ballot answer, write-in or total is filed as a person
race dates are YYYY-MM-DD
outcomes are codes the page knows
votes and percentages are never negative
no percentage over 100
a person's record holds each race once
checks.note: the same contest twice in one county under one person: an alias joined twice or a split rule that moved a race back

checks.check: a contest's percentages add up to no more than 100
checks.note: more than 100 means rows from two contests, or one candidate twice, were put together

checks.check: each candidate's percentage agrees with their share of the contest's votes
checks.note: within 2 points; contests with write-ins on file elsewhere can differ

checks.check: no ballot answer is listed as a candidate
every past election has an id, a date and its contests
every past race row has its fields, a date or year, and votes and a percentage in range where counted
no ballot answer is filed as a person

races where the member seated is not the count's leader (a runoff, a death, a contest)

checks.check: every person in Crawl's records is someone the site knows
every item's sources exist and are web links

no text garbled by a wrong character set
